references.text: The entire event where Peter denies Jesus three times, culminating in him remembering Jesus' words about the denial after the rooster crows.
A parallel account of Peter denying Jesus three times before the rooster crows, found in the Gospel of Mark.
Luke's version of Peter's denial, which also includes the detail that Peter remembers Jesus' words after the rooster crows.
John's account of Peter's denial, offering a different perspective on the event.
